newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Port conditions update - S.Korea - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - S.Korea - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
SOUTH KOREA, Aug 19 - Busan - 172 vessels in port (70 at berth, 102 at anchorage). Usually 2-3 days delay due to berth congestion.
Ulsan - 106 vessels in port (69 at berth, 37 at anchorage). Usually 1-2 days delay due to berth congestion.
Pohang - 38 vessels in port (31 at berth, 7 at anchorage). No delays.
Inchon - 89 vessels in port (58 at berth, 31 at anchorage). Usually 1-2 days delay due to berth congestion.
